segments.name: Singapore → Darwin
segments.reason: No road reaches Australia. The Indonesian archipelago breaks the land connection and the Timor Sea has no fixed crossing.

segments.name: Sydney → Santiago
segments.reason: The South Pacific. The longest crossing on the route by far.

segments.name: Turbo → Panama City
segments.reason: The Darién Gap. The only break in the Pan-American Highway: roughly 100 km of roadless rainforest and swamp between Colombia and Panama.
